world.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original premium freshwater fishing slot game background, cinematic wide landscape about 2:1, 2048 pixels wide if possible.
Primary request: a beautiful northern freshwater lake at golden dawn, emerald-green clear water, dark pine-covered mountains, soft mist above the lake, an old warm cedar fishing dock at the right. On the FAR RIGHT, an original charismatic middle-aged angler with a thick graying brown beard, olive canvas fishing hat with a small feather, red checked shirt and warm tan fishing vest. He proudly holds one magnificent freshly caught green largemouth bass at waist height. Friendly realistic face, outdoorsman warmth, mature high-end illustrated game world.
Composition: left and center 70 percent calm darker teal lake water and softly detailed distant pines/mist, deliberately quiet for a large rectangular reel-board overlay. The angler occupies the rightmost 25 percent, waist-up, his entire hat and head visible with generous top margin, bass fully within right area. A small red vintage pickup and weathered tackle boxes partly visible at far right behind dock, not in reel zone. Rod rests diagonally at extreme right edge. Dawn rays skim rippling lake and worn cedar planks. Actual rich outdoor environment, no empty gradient, no central arch or board frame.
Style: beautiful hand-painted 2.5D volumetric game concept art with believable anatomy, tactile canvas and wool, intricate fish scales and wet highlights, warm amber dawn light against pine green and deep lake teal. Cinematic painterly realism, strong depth, polished original character design, no thick outlines or cartoon plastic.
Constraints: no text, words, numbers, labels, license plate lettering, logos, watermarks, UI, reels, grid, slot machine or game frame. No copied commercial provider characters. Freshwater outdoors, not an ocean.

atlas.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Attached original lake-and-angler world is a STYLE AND CHARACTER reference only. Create NEW transparent symbols matching its original friendly bearded angler, warm dawn light, pine greens, lake teal, worn copper and red canvas. No environment in atlas.
Asset type: original premium freshwater fishing game sprite atlas, true transparent alpha. Twelve complete isolated icons, FOUR columns × THREE rows, landscape 4:3 canvas ideally 2048x1536. Center icons at x12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%; y16.67%,50%,83.33%. BIG empty transparent gutters. Each complete icon fits within 65% of its equal square cell. No overlap or clipping.
Style: exceptional hand-painted 2.5D game illustration with believable fish anatomy, tactile scaled wet skin, weathered enamel, brass fishing equipment, modeled dimensional materials. Strong distinct silhouettes at 40px. Coherent warm upper-left light with teal cool fill, mature whimsical realism, no cartoon outlines or emoji.
Exact reading order:
Row1 col1: magnificent green largemouth bass leaping in a compact curve, side view, bright detailed scales and ivory belly, open mouth, all fins/tail intact, NO water splash and NO number.
Row1 col2: smaller warm golden-yellow freshwater perch with dark vertical bars and orange fins, side view arcing opposite direction, clearly distinct from green bass, no splash or numbers.
Row1 col3: compact fishing tackle set, beautifully crafted brass reel and short curved wooden rod with line and a red-white float, fully contained compact diagonal silhouette, no long thin rod leaving cell.
Row1 col4: vintage red pickup truck with cream roof, three-quarter front view, outdoorsy and worn, no branding or plate letters.
Row2 col1: weathered dark iron anchor with brass highlights and a loop of thick cream rope, compact classic silhouette.
Row2 col2: uppercase A, freestanding chunky sculpted serif letter, ruby-red enamel face with thick weathered brass bevel, no backing plaque.
Row2 col3: uppercase K, freestanding chunky serif letter, warm amber-gold enamel face with thick weathered brass bevel.
Row2 col4: uppercase Q, freestanding chunky serif letter, berry-pink enamel face with thick weathered brass bevel.
Row3 col1: uppercase J, freestanding chunky serif letter, turquoise-blue enamel face with thick weathered brass bevel.
Row3 col2: compact red-and-ivory fishing motorboat with dark outboard engine and small windshield, three-quarter view, no water, no words, scatter icon.
Row3 col3: head-and-shoulders portrait of original reference angler: friendly middle-aged face, thick graying brown beard, olive fishing hat with small feather, red checked shirt/tan vest, entire hat fully visible, wild portrait with no text.
Row3 col4: antique brass-and-teal round fishing medallion, engraved fish relief around the rim, large plain cream center reserved for native number, no number.
Constraints: only text is specified A K Q J letters. No other words, labels, numbers, logos, watermark, checkerboard, backdrop, floor, gridline or cell box. All twelve icons isolated on real transparent alpha, opaque naturally antialiased forms, no outside cast shadows or big glow halos. No copied provider assets.
atlas.spacingEdit:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Change ONLY scale and layout of attached original fishing sprite atlas. Preserve exact designs, colors, materials, character identity, A/K/Q/J glyphs, reading order, 4:3 canvas and true transparent alpha.
Make EVERY symbol 60% OF ITS CURRENT width and height. Do not enlarge anything to fill space. The required result has twelve smaller symbols and LARGE obvious empty transparent gutters, safely separated for sprite cropping. Preserve entire bass and perch fins/tails, complete tackle line and float, entire truck, rope anchor, all glyphs, boat, angler hat/shoulders and medallion. No clipping. If an edge was clipped, repair only that edge to complete the object.
Center icons exactly in equal 4-column 3-row grid: x12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%; y16.6667%,50%,83.3333%. Clear transparent margins on all sides within each cell. Order row1 greenbass/goldperch/tackle/redtruck; row2 anchor/A/K/Q; row3 J/motorboat/anglerportrait/blankfishingmedallion.
All art surfaces remain opaque with naturally antialiased edges. Outside objects truly transparent. No new text, numbers, labels, logos, backgrounds, grids, checkerboards, shadows, extra glows, splashes or decorative objects. Reduce all twelve icons substantially and increase empty space, retain premium painted materials.
